resources.string: GeekBridge for your computer
GeekBridge needs its free app on your computer too. Get the download page to the computer, install it, then come back here and scan the QR code it shows.
Get it to your computer
Pick any app you already use, such as email or a chat with yourself. GeekBridge sends nothing itself and needs no account.

What to do on the computer
GeekBridge for your computer
Download GeekBridge for this computer:
Open the link above and download the file for your system (Linux, Windows or macOS).
Install it and open GeekBridge.
Click “Link a phone”, then scan the QR code with GeekBridge on your phone.
Scan QR code
Point the camera at the QR code on your computer’s screen. It reads on its own; nothing is recorded or sent.
Camera view. Point it at the QR code on your computer.
QR code found
That QR code is not a GeekBridge pairing code. On your computer click “Link a phone” and scan that one.
Allow the camera to scan
GeekBridge uses the camera only on this screen, to read the QR code your computer shows. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent. You can also open the link from your camera app or paste it instead.
Allow camera
The camera is turned off for GeekBridge
Turn on the Camera permission in the app’s settings to scan here. Or use your phone’s camera app on the QR code, or paste the link.
The camera could not be started. Close other apps that use it, or use your phone’s camera app on the QR code, or paste the link.
